text:
sasha: Heads-up: I opened a tiny PR to rework the Optimize toolkit examples and fix a couple of broken anchors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512. Main fixes: update SDK snippets to v2, replace old quant keys, and add a short note on cache priming for streaming responses. cc @lin @rahul

lin: thanks — quick skim looks good. one nit: the snippet uses `OptimizeClient()` but our SDK v2 exposes `OptimizeClient.from_env()` in examples. can you switch that?

sasha: yeah will update. current snippet in the PR: ```python
client = OptimizeClient()
profile = {"quant": {"bits":8, "per_channel":True}}
client.apply_profile("my-model", profile)
```

rahul: FYI the `apply_profile` name got renamed to `set_quant_profile` in SDK v2 for clarity. Also, `bits` is legacy; new schema uses `mode: "int8"` or `mode: "fp16"`. I can push a tiny fix if you want.

maya: small request: add a one-line migration summary at the top of the page that lists exact key renames (legacy -> v2). People skim for bullet lists.

sasha: good call, adding a 3-line bullet list. also going to add a tiny helper function that converts legacy dicts to the new shape (local utility, link to follow-up PR with unit tests).

lin: also saw a linkcheck failure locally: the PR references `/optimize/quant-configs-v2#channelwise` but the anchor is actually `#channel-wise`. i'll patch the anchor in the page and update the link. that fixes CI linkcheck.

docs-bot: Build started for docs/pull/512 checks: linkcheck, lint, mkdocs-build

rahul: pushed a commit that updates the snippet to use `OptimizeClient.from_env()` and `set_quant_profile` and converts the example profile to {"quant": {"mode":"int8","channelwise":true}}. Also added an example of expected output after migration (before -> after).

maya: suggest adding a one-sentence warning under "Performance notes": "Quantized int8 models can change batching behavior; validate p95 when you increase batch size." Link to perf playbook optional.

sasha: added the warning and a short pointer to /optimize/perf-playbook. 

lin: lint caught a long inline code line in a markdown snippet, trimming it now. also replaced a merged image path with the new assets path.

ci-bot: Linkcheck failed - missing anchor /optimize/quant-configs-v2#channel-wise.

lin: fixed anchor and re-pushed. ci-bot: please re-run.

docs-bot: Build succeeded for docs/pull/512 (linkcheck, lint, mkdocs-build)

rahul: one follow-up idea: include a one-paragraph FAQ at the bottom: "When should I rebatch after quantizing?" with a short recommendation and a pointer to the notebook in examples that shows a small benchmark.

maya: yes please. that notebook (examples/optimize/bench-small.py) exists but we should link to it and add a short note about using MOCK_OPTIMIZE=1 to avoid hitting prod in CI.

sasha: done — added FAQ link and mock-mode note. final pass looks green, will merge after docs-bot approves. thanks team! :sparkles:
